title: D6-03 link 2: bent bar 8x3 + J2/J3 hubs (Ti-6Al-4V)
frame: STEP coordinates = the part's group-local frame (equal to the rig frame when the group is at identity: x anterior, y up, z lateral, origin = GH centre)

principal_axes_extents.note: extents of the part along its principal axes of inertia (density-free)

sketch_plane.note: the plane of the two joint axes through GH; 2D x = joint J2 axis, y = in-plane toward joint J3; the bar is this outline extruded symmetric to its width (both sides of the plane)

centre_line_chain.turn: left (CCW, centre on the GH side when heading out)
left (CCW, centre on the GH side when heading out)

cross_section_mid_longest_arc.note: section square to the centre line at the middle of the longest arc; x = radial (away from that arc's centre), y = along the sketch-plane normal (bar width)

side_view_outline_z3.2.note: section by the plane parallel to the sketch plane at +3.2 mm (inside the 1.5 mm pocket rim, clear of the 0.5 rounds): the drawn side-view outline, 2D in the sketch-plane axes

side_view_mid_plane_z0.note: section by the sketch plane itself (through the pocket)

pocket.note: pocket width = 2 x wall offset; rim = bar half-width - wall offset; end radius = pocket half-width
